metcon.name: Partner workout
metcon.description:
30 min AMRAP
300 m run together
X power cleans
2 rope climbs
10 burpee over bar
Round 1: 20 reps @ 40/30
Round 2: 18 reps @ 50/35
Round 3: 16 reps @ 60/40
Round 4: 14 reps @ 70/45
Round 5: 12 reps @ 80/50
Round 6: 10 reps @ 90/55
Round 7: 8 reps @ 100/60

hypertrophy.reasoning: Power cleans and burpees heavily tax anterior chain; accessory work targets posterior chain and arms for balance.
